findings.body: A client can commit the sign-off decision using repository-local `user.name` and `user.email` without having a global Git identity. The review clone does not inherit that local configuration, so `git commit-tree` can fail before Autoreview runs, leaving `forge decision accept` unable to complete. The tests miss this because `tests/conftest.py:111-120` supplies a global identity. Set an identity for these synthetic commits. [Git's commit-tree documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-commit-tree) describes its identity requirements.
findings.title: Set an identity for the synthetic review commits
